data.description: Discover Unmatched Elegance at Claydon House in the Heart of Mohammed Bin Rashid Area
data.display_address: Claydon House, Mohammed Bin Rashid City, Dubai
data.long_description:
Claydon House offers an exceptional living experience in the heart of Mohammed Bin Rashid City, brought to life by renowned developer Ellington Properties.

The 38-storey complex is thoughtfully designed with a modern aesthetic, offering expansive apartments ranging from one to four bedrooms. Its prime location offers breathtaking views of the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary and direct access to a pristine 2 km lagoon.

The interiors are designed to foster comfort and style, with large panoramic windows that fill each space with natural light and offer panoramic vistas. Residents will enjoy exclusive amenities such as a rooftop gym, swimming pools, a children’s Montessori area, and a clubhouse with a library and gaming space. With an enviable location just minutes from major landmarks like Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, and Dubai International Airport, Claydon House combines the tranquility of nature with the excitement of city living.
